verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a first-party Registrar API covering searching and checking domains, and a probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec, so programmatic availability checks are directly supported. The evidence is a single thin API-reference line with no detail on request or response shape and no stated rate limits, which the story explicitly asks for. missing for 10: documented rate limits for search/check calls, detailed availability-check endpoint documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the check API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check domain availability programmatically — a documented check/search API my code or agent can call with clear rate limits

citations.quote: Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
